env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd plain
logos run .
cmp stdout ../want.txt
cd ../interp
logos run .
cmp stdout ../want.txt
cd ../quoted
logos run .
cmp stdout ../want.txt
cd ../closer
logos run .
cmp stdout ../want.txt

# Eject the controls first so they run even on a toolchain with the regression.
cd ../plain
logos eject -o out
cd out
go build -o count$GOEXE .
exec ./count$GOEXE
cmp stdout ../../want.txt

cd ../../interp
logos eject -o out
cd out
go build -o count$GOEXE .
exec ./count$GOEXE
cmp stdout ../../want.txt

cd ../../quoted
logos eject -o out
cd out
go build -o count$GOEXE .
exec ./count$GOEXE
cmp stdout ../../want.txt

cd ../../closer
logos eject -o out
cd out
go build -o count$GOEXE .
exec ./count$GOEXE
cmp stdout ../../want.txt

-- want.txt --
v 1
-- plain/go.mod --
module example.com/plain

go 1.27
-- plain/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"
)

func Count[T any]() int {
	n := 0
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		_ = f.Name
		n++
	}
	return n
}

func one() int {
	return Count[struct{ N [len([1]string{"("})]byte }]()
}

func main() { fmt.Println("v", one()) }
-- interp/go.mod --
module example.com/interp

go 1.27
-- interp/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"
)

func Count[T any]() int {
	n := 0
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		_ = f.Name
		n++
	}
	return n
}

func one() int {
	return Count[struct{ N [len([1]string{$"{ "x" }"})]byte }]()
}

func main() { fmt.Println("v", one()) }

package main

	"comptime"
	"fmt"

func Count[T any]() int {
	n := 0
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		_ = f.Name
		n++
	}
	return n
}

func one() int {
	return Count[struct{ N [len([1]string{$"{ "(" }"})]byte }]()

func main() { fmt.Println("v", one()) }

go 1.27
-- closer/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"
)

func Count[T any]() int {
	n := 0
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		_ = f.Name
		n++
	}
	return n
}

func one() int {
	return Count[struct{ N [len([1]string{$"{ ")" }"})]byte }]()
}

func main() { fmt.Println("v", one()) }
